headline: Congress Files Delhi High Court Petition Against Meta Content Policy
seoTitle: Meta Adjusts Instagram Algorithms In India
metaDescription: The Congress party has initiated legal action against Meta in the Delhi High Court, alleging that automated content blocking affects political outreach.
aiSummaryBullets: The Congress party filed a petition in the Delhi High Court challenging Meta's content moderation practices.
Opposition leaders claim that automated systems are restricting legitimate political content related to Rahul Gandhi.
Meta representatives previously met with Congress officials to discuss concerns over account suspensions and government compliance.
aiContextParagraph: The political tension stems from allegations that Meta's automated recommendation and moderation systems are suppressing content critical of the Narendra Modi government. The Congress party reports that its ability to communicate with voters is hampered, specifically citing the restriction of tributes and messages concerning Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi. While the Congress party views these actions as a threat to transparent political discourse, Meta has reportedly attributed some of these content decisions to compliance with Indian government orders. Earlier in November, Meta stated it had adjusted Instagram recommendation algorithms in the country to limit the visibility of violent and suggestive material. Following meetings between Meta executives and Congress leaders to address account suspensions and bias allegations, the party has now escalated the matter by filing a formal petition with the Delhi High Court.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to significant coverage across four independent outlets and recent high-level meetings between a major political party and a global tech corporation.
